venue: ACM SIGCHI conference track (acmart manuscript/review workflow; CHI 2027 publication formats)

requirements.title: acmart manuscript/review format
requirements.requirement: Initial submissions use the 1-column format; LaTeX authors use \documentclass[manuscript,review]{acmart}, and anonymous submissions use \documentclass[manuscript,review,anonymous]{acmart}.

requirements.title: Per-track page/word limits
requirements.requirement: Page and word limits are set by each track's call for participation; page length is counted in the 1-column submission format.

requirements.title: Anonymous submission option
requirements.requirement: When the track requires anonymity, submissions use the acmart anonymous option which replaces author block with 'ANONYMOUS AUTHOR(S)'; whether anonymization applies is track-specific.
